El Nino Worsens, Threatening Global Food Prices and Asian Droughts

A worsening El Nino phenomenon is projected to increase global food prices and potentially cause droughts across Asia. Experts indicate a high risk of a record-breaking El Nino this year, which could lead to widespread droughts in the region and subsequent price hikes for food worldwide.
